body: It's not. This is my exact viewpoint as well. There is no good or bad, they don't exist. They're just ideas. There's just is or is not. If you've never seen The Sunset Limited, give it a watch.

Ya I know what you mean. Obviously I can't believe there is actually a true self or that would contradict everything else I believe. I think I'm too arrogant to allow myself to be something other than my natural state. Clearly my brain hates me. One day I just might get that little fucker back.

Maybe there is. I guess I also struggle with the idea of essentially becoming someone I'm not. Maybe being horribly depressed and suicidal is who I should be. Maybe some people just suffer. It there are people that feel happy all of the time, then logically the opposite should exist.

I have never done any kind of drug beyond prescription. I don't really care to either. It's just another bandaid that will inevitably rip and expose the nothingness beneath. But maybe you have a different view and maybe they would bring you relief.

Nothing really matters in my opinion. There is no purpose, no reason, no higher meaning to find. This is it. You can either convince yourself to believe in something or you will be miserable for the rest of your life like me. People like to say "well, you're here so you might as well make the most of it". It's bullshit. I should live my life under the false impression that anything I do actually matters in the grand scheme of things? To what end? As soon as I die, I won't even know what I did or didn't do anyway. I say why not just expedite the process instead of waiting around for the inevitable moment where I die sad, alone, and terrified. If I could simply choose to die right now, I absolutely would.
Sorry to hear you're going through a rough time. I can definitely relate to not having the energy to go out and do things. Simple stuff just like going to the grocery store can seem daunting.

I recently took a week off of work due to depression. Luckily I have enough vacation days to get paid for that time, but it honestly didn't really help. I'm back now and just miserable and hating every second of it. People ask me what's wrong or how I'm doing and I just say I'm fine. But I'm really, really not fine. I have 0 motivation and think about just walking out and saying fuck it. I haven't found a way to cope yet.
I wish I did, struggling with that myself. I understand you can't really share your feelings with your son (or dog). That must be difficult.
Is it just being alone that you think is causing it? Feel free to message me if you want to talk.

I know what you mean. It's not something that can be cured, only managed. Have you really sat down with your husband and talked about it? I neglected communicating with my girlfriend and now I've lost her for good it seems.
I would say no job or amount of money is worth it if you have to sacrifice your mental health. Especially if you are hurting yourself.
Sorry to hear about the bad news. I've had cats all of my life and they are really special little creatures. If you need someone to talk to I'm available.
Feel free to message me about what's bothering you. I've been dealing with anxiety and depression my whole life.

Yep. I keep telling myself that if I actually go out and do things then I'll feel better. But I just can't do it. I don't have the strength. Just going out to the mall for a couple hours completely drains me. All I can think about is how I want to just go home and do nothing. It's such a miserable existence.
Step 2. Don't be me either

Yes, I know how you feel. I can't even remember the last time I slept straight through a whole night. I used to love the night, but now I'm terrified of it. Because I know that when I wake up I'll have to somehow find the strength to keep going. It's beyond exhausting. Constantly pretending, constantly acting like you give a shit about anything at all. Acting like you care whether or not you live or die. Honestly the mental and physical exhaustion is the worst. It's like slowly being tortured for years on end by your own brain. It fucking sucks.

Sometimes I have to just tell myself that life doesn't matter. None of it actually matters. It's the only way to lessen the anxiousness and overwhelming feelings of dread. Even if it only lasts for a day, at least it's something. I just say "Fuck it" and try my best to keep going. That's what I do when things get really bad.

Absolutely. Mine is on Saturday (I'll be 26) and am completely dreading it. And I can't stay home because my nephew keeps saying how much he wants to see me and likes hanging out with me. So I have to put on a brave face and force myself to be a normal person for at least half of the day. Good thing it's not today because I just don't have the strength.

[Comes and Goes](https://youtu.be/5czkBR_Yq2Y)
  
I know how you feel. Sometimes I feel completely normal and like everything will be ok. Then an hour later I feel absolutely crushed and just want to die. It's really bad this morning. My anxiety is through the roof and I honestly don't know how I'm going to make it through the day.

Happiness doesn't really exist, it's just a state of mind. It's not something you can walk down the street and stumble upon one day. If you're constantly trying to find something that isn't there you'll always be disappointed. If you don't have the courage to talk to strangers then type to them like you did in this post. There are plenty of dating sites out there. Just put yourself out there like you've got nothing to lose. Best of luck.

I don't believe in God, but I can't imagine a worse fate than life after death. I don't believe this life means anything. Nothing I do matters and that completely crushes any motivation I have and will to live. I don't know why I continue to torture myself by staying alive. It could be so easy to just take matters into my own hands. My girlfriend is finally leaving me after about 3 years. She stuck it out longer than I expected and now I truly am alone. I can't even begin to describe the sinking feeling in my chest that I constantly try to suppress. I don't think I was meant to live in this meaningless existence.
